release_notes.title: Quick replies, clear tasks and Notion fixes
release_notes.summary: Small requests stay brief, checklists follow your goals, and Notion handles results and connection status more reliably.
improved: Quick command lists use a shorter reference, without project setup.
Real work keeps its project guidance and original goals when you say continue.
fixed: Greetings, help and command lists no longer become tracked tasks.
Command names no longer become checklist steps.
Message timestamps no longer run into checklist labels.
Notion tool results stay in compact cards instead of showing raw source text.
Working Notion chats keep their connection status when messages are redrawn or hidden.
notes: Automated regressions cover startup, commands, Studio detection fixtures and updating. Live AI accounts, response speed and real Studio sessions were not tested.

sections.title: 💬 Quick replies for small requests
items: **Greetings stay simple:** hello, thanks, help and quick questions no longer start a project task or checklist.
**Faster command discovery:** asking to list commands skips project memory, skills, templates and checkpoint setup, and uses a shorter command reference.

sections.title: ✅ Tasks follow your goal
items: **Meaningful task names:** checklists describe what you want accomplished, rather than tool names such as list_commands. Old command-list entries no longer become the active checklist goal.
**Continue keeps the plan:** real work retains its original goal and project guidance when you ask to continue.

sections.title: 🎨 Cleaner checklist text
items: **Readable labels:** chat timestamps no longer get copied against the task name. Times written inside your instructions stay intact.

sections.title: 🛠️ Notion reliability
items: **Readable results:** tool results show as compact cards instead of raw source text.
**Accurate connection:** working chats stay connected when Notion redraws or hides older messages.

sections.title: 🧪 Regression checks
items: Automated checks cover quick requests, task retention, command schemas, startup, Studio detection fixtures, updating and Windows/Mac builds. Live AI accounts, response speed and real Studio sessions were not tested.

release_notes.title: Name your skills and a clearer Skills layout
release_notes.summary: Give your skills a name, or let PlazCode name them for you. Learning and library options now have clearer spacing.
added: An optional Skill name box appears above Skill instructions. Leave it blank and PlazCode creates a short name from your instructions.
improved: Release descriptions explain what changes mean for you in plain language.
fixed: Learning and library options has its own space below the editor. Expanded controls stay on separate rows.
Clearing a skill name uses the current instructions to name it, rather than an older description.
notes: Automated tests cover existing startup, tools and updating. Live signed-in AI accounts and real Studio sessions were not tested.

sections.title: ✏️ Name your skills
items: **Choose a name:** a new optional name box sits above Skill instructions.
**Automatic naming:** leave the name blank and PlazCode makes a short name from what you wrote. You can rename saved skills too.

sections.title: 🎨 Clearer Skills layout
items: **More breathing room:** Learning and library options is separated from the editor. Opening it keeps its buttons and settings from crowding each other.
**Keep your workflow:** saving, project scope, importing JSON or text, and exporting JSON work as before.

sections.title: 📝 Easier release notes
items: **Plain language:** update descriptions explain what changed and how it helps, without requiring scripting knowledge.

sections.title: ✅ Checked before release
items: Automated checks cover Skills, startup, commands, updating and Windows/Mac builds. Live AI accounts and real Studio sessions were not tested.

release_notes.title: Responsive commands, stable checklists and skill imports
release_notes.summary: Recover from stuck command waits, continue safely after Stop, and import your own skills.
added: Skills accepts exported JSON files, text files and pasted instructions as new local candidates. Existing skills are preserved.
Skills has one instructions box with Save, Import and Export. Explicitly saved guidance is matched to the current project without requiring a separate goal or claiming it was tested.
improved: Native MCP requests use one deadline across pipe writes, notifications and response reads. Missing extension callbacks resolve with an explicit timeout.
Fresh native requests wait for the previous loop and pending tool cancellation to settle instead of being discarded.
Main checklist tasks survive follow-ups and page refreshes in the same tab. Status updates and appended work preserve existing labels; explicit replacement requests can start a new plan.
fixed: A stale soft generation flag can no longer hold an unfinished command indefinitely. Inactivity ends the wait without running partial commands.
Automatic updates use the installer helper embedded in the running build. Both automatic and standalone Windows launchers set a process-level execution policy.
Completed tool watchdog timers are cleared and late worker replies cannot settle a request twice.
Checklist labels exclude message timestamp elements, with wider row and header spacing. Literal times inside user instructions remain intact.
Missed DOM tooltip/style reads and temporary editor cleanup are guarded across supported AI adapters. Deep semantic composer boundaries survive inserted wrappers.
Debug report is separated from the Settings grid; effort aligns beneath PlazCode and visible desktop, bar and extension version labels include v.
notes: Automated regression and platform tests are required before release. Live signed-in Claude, ChatGPT, Notion and Studio sessions remain unverified.

sections.title: 🛠️ Commands and continuation
items: **Bounded waits:** MCP chatter, blocked pipes, missing worker replies and stale generation flags no longer keep these waits alive indefinitely.
**Stop → Continue:** the next request waits for cancellation to settle. Partial or uncertain commands are never replayed automatically.
**DOM recovery:** safer reads and editor cleanup across AI adapters, with bounded lookups and no extra polling.

sections.title: ☑️ Stable task checklist
items: **Keep the main tasks:** continue and keep going retain the plan, including after a tab refresh. Change it only when asked; update statuses or append requested work.
**Cleaner spacing:** more room between rows, icons and headings; message timestamps are excluded from task labels.

sections.title: 📥 Import skills
items: **Simple Skills:** type instructions and Save. Import/Export JSON or text; saved guidance adapts to the current project.

sections.title: 🔧 Windows updater
items: **Current helper:** automatic updates use the helper embedded in this build. Built-in and manual launchers set a process-level execution policy; checksum and rollback checks stay in place.

sections.title: 🎨 Interface fixes
items: **Spacing and versions:** separate Debug report cards, align effort under PlazCode and prefix displayed versions with v.

sections.title: ✅ Checked before release
items: Regression fixtures and native platform checks. Live signed-in AI accounts and Studio behavior remain unverified.

release_notes.title: DeepSeek Ultracode and smoother Notion startup
release_notes.summary: A focused DeepSeek thinking mode, less repeated work and more reliable Notion startup.
added: DeepSeek has its own Ultracode method with 13 context-aware Roblox skills. Replies follow your latest request’s language.
improved: DeepSeek Ultracode receives its full method once per confirmed conversation session, then uses short reminders. Other providers keep the existing global Ultracode method.
Notion starts with a short handshake and receives the full task rules with the existing tool-list reply. No extra startup round trip is added.
fixed: Firefox now receives the complete Notion paste payload when the browser creates a separate clipboard transfer.
Startup errors stop safely and release the chat lock. The agent only becomes ready after the required handshake succeeds.
notes: Production-code browser fixtures pass in Chromium and Firefox. Live signed-in provider latency and all account-specific behavior have not been verified.

sections.title: 🧠 DeepSeek Ultracode
items: **13 skills:** a focused Roblox method, including safer data saving, UI and API checks. Replies use your language.
**Less repeated work:** sends the full method once per session, then uses short reminders. Keeps careful checks and asks once before an unapproved large build.
**Other AIs:** keep the existing Ultracode method.

sections.title: ⚡ Smoother Notion startup
items: **Shorter first message:** startup uses a small handshake. Full task instructions follow in the existing tool-list reply.
**Firefox fix:** startup pastes now carry the complete message.
**Error recovery:** failed startup releases the chat lock. PlazCode only says it is ready after the handshake succeeds.

sections.title: ✅ Checked before release
items: Chromium, Firefox and platform regression checks, plus the macOS desktop lifetime check. Live signed-in account behavior remains unverified.

release_notes.title: Faster Ultracode and more reliable chat
release_notes.summary: Less repeated work, easier Settings and fixes for Notion and screenshots.
added: Updates is back as its own sidebar page.
Settings sections expand and collapse while keeping their title and description visible.
improved: Ultracode uses a 62% smaller instruction pack, reuses verified information and avoids repeated planning and checks. Core skills and verification requirements are preserved.
Workspace pages and the sidebar scroll within the window and use visible theme-matched scrollbars.
The full effort label matches its selected level. Indicators show Ultracode; the Settings dropdown keeps Ultracode (Beta).
fixed: Notion finds send controls in tall composers, ignores hidden old controls and waits for rich-editor controls to become ready.
Large locked Notion tool feedback can use verified small text pastes when native editing and file uploads fail.
Studio screenshots use the Roblox bridge even when AgentScript is selected.
ChatGPT screenshot uploads use one transport, verify a new attachment and commit once. Failed uploads are reported without sending text-only feedback.
notes: Automated checks use production code and browser fixtures. Live signed-in providers and Studio/Blender sessions are not verified. The instruction-size reduction is not a measured provider speedup or benchmark result.

sections.title: ⚡ Faster Ultracode
items: **Less waiting:** a 62% smaller instruction pack, less repeated planning, and reuse of verified information.
**Careful problem solving:** keeps its skills, safety checks and verification.

sections.title: 🖥️ Easier workspace
items: **Scrolling:** reach the bottom of pages, with scrollbars that match your theme.
**Settings:** click a section to open or close it. Updates is back in the sidebar.
**Effort labels:** the whole label matches the level’s color. The bar says Ultracode; Settings keeps Ultracode (Beta).

sections.title: 🔧 Chat and screenshot fixes
items: **Notion:** better send-button detection, including tall composers and delayed startup controls. Large tool replies have a verified text-send fallback.
**Screenshots:** Studio captures use the right bridge. ChatGPT waits for an attachment and sends it once; failed uploads show an error.
